description: Check that cited web pages contain the quoted text. Pass `citations` (1-20 {url, quote?, claimed_title?, claimed_date?}). GAIP fetches each public page once (robots.txt respected), and per citation returns QUOTE_FOUND / QUOTE_NOT_FOUND_IN_FETCHED_VERSION / SOURCE_UNREACHABLE / SOURCE_NOT_FOUND_404 / CONTENT_NOT_TEXT / ROBOTS_DISALLOWED, the fetch time, HTTP status, SHA-256 of the fetched bytes, a matched excerpt of at most 300 characters and a receipt. No page copies are kept. Facts about the fetched version only; pages change. Not legal advice and not a judgement on any author. Free, read-only, no account. Inputs must be public and non-personal; calling declares that (data_classification defaults to PUBLIC).
name: gaip_citation_witness
title: Witness citations
